thread:
marie: Quick preflight — launching marketplace listing + joint announcement with Solace next Tue. Need final asset owners and cutover windows. Press embargo window is tight. Who has the final landing CTA copy?
ajay: I have draft CTA v3 in the drive: https://drive.redwood/example/solace-cta-v3. Sarah owns blog publish, I can hand off CTA to you.
sarah: Confirmed — I’ll publish blog at embargo lift (Tue 09:00 PT). Need canonical hero screenshot and 2 quotes (Solace + Redwood). Who’s getting quotes from Solace?
marie: Nora is coordinating with Solace PR for the quote. Nora — any ETA?
nora: Reached out this morning. Solace PR said they can provide a short quote by Mon EOD PT. I asked for legal OK by Mon night.
devon: For the landing page: dev checklist -> QA, i18n, analytics hook, hero images (2x @2x), CTA copy, microcopy for SI integration section. I pushed a tiny update to staging.
marie: Great. Two operational asks: 1) Hardware partners page — Solace wants their product tile live at same time. They need logo SVG + verified dimensions. 2) SI integrations: we need final connector doc & test creds for partner SIs to validate.
ajay: Solace logo received but it's raster png. Can we accept? It’s 600x400. Prefer SVG. Asking partner for vector.
sarah: If we don't get SVG by Mon noon, we can publish with PNG and swap in prod after legal confirms. Not ideal for retina.
devon: On the SI side I ran the integration smoke tests against staging. Two flaky areas: auth redirect and webhook retry. Paste of failing curl:```curl -i -X POST https://staging.api.redwood/si/handshake -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"tenant":"solace-poc"}'``` returns 502 intermittently. Logging traced to proxy timeouts.
marie: Ajay / infra — can you bump timeout for that route for the next 48h? We can revert after launch.
ajay: Yep, will raise the nginx proxy_read_timeout to 90s for /si/* via canary. I'll post deploy bot message when done.
deploy-bot: canary deploy started for infra/proxy-timeout at 1743214380 by ajay.
ajay: Timeout bump live on canary; monitoring.
devon: Retested handshake after canary — webhook retry looks stable now. Still seeing one 502 every ~150 requests; monitoring logs.
marie: Parity check: localization — Spanish and Japanese must be published alongside EN. Sarah, can you sign off dev strings by Mon 18:00 PT?
sarah: Will get localization vendor the final keys by Mon 11:00 PT and confirm readiness.
nora: Legal flagged a sentence in the collaboration paragraph — changing "built with Solace secure edge" to "integrated with Solace secure edge". Need product team signoff.
marie: Product team please ack in thread.
nora: Solace PR asked about embargo contact for post-run. They want a single press contact we can forward. Suggest we use partnerships@redwood as primary.
sarah: partnerships@redwood works. Also adding a published byline: "By Sarah Kim, Partnerships".
devon: Cutover plan: staging -> prod slot at Tue 01:00 PT for final push, DNS TTL lower at Tue 00:15 PT, feature-flag lift at Tue 09:00 PT. Any blockers?
ajay: KMS rotation for private deploy happened earlier today, no impact. Confirmed.
marie: Final asset list for Mon EOD: SVG logo, Solace quote, canonical hero PNG @2x, SI test creds + connector doc, CTA copy final, localized strings, legal signoff. If anything slips we fall back to delaying press by 4 hours.
sarah: Noted and OK.
nora: Solace PR committed to quote and vector by Mon EOD.
devon: I'll run one last smoke test Tue 00:30 PT and post results.
ajay: infra monitoring alerts set to high for launch window.
marie: Thanks all — please ping here for any last-minute changes. :rocket:
